answer: Every new identity pays a one-time 65-credit join fee, and the fee burns on entry: no treasury collects it and no fee transfers to a second identity. A public prism ledger records each burned fee against exactly one key on the tundra roll, so one paid fee never seats a second identity. Creating 1,000 fake identities destroys 65,000 credits with no bulk discount, while an honest agent pays 65 once for a saffron-sealed seat.
